title: A role with permission None adds nothing to a role that can read

source.quote: For example, if a user is a member of a role with the Read permission, and also a member of a role with None permission, that user has Read permissions.
source.supports: the user has Europe's Read permission, with its row filter

derivation: NoAccess has the None permission; Europe has Read, with its filter: the user sees Europe's sales, 130.
